title: Naim Montazeri, Ph.D.
text:
I am an Assistant Professor at the University of Florida with over 15 years of experience in microbial food safety, risk assessment, and predictive modeling. My work integrates experimental microbiology with R-based data analysis to evaluate pathogen persistence, transfer, and control in foods and agricultural systems, with particular experience in high-risk ready-to-eat foods, agricultural water, and risk-based strategies that support food safety decision-making and regulatory compliance. I also have experience applying FDA BAM, ISO, ASTM, AOAC, and EPA-aligned methods in food safety, sanitation, and validation studies.
My work is cross-functional, combining microbiology, data analysis, applied food safety, stakeholder outreach, science communication, and mentoring. Prior to my current role, I worked on sanitation validation, product development, processing, and quality evaluation in laboratory and pilot-scale environments, including antimicrobial interventions, cooking and processing parameters, sensory quality, and product stability.
